bg.use: Main background: the page, the editor, panels that hold code.

bg-alt.use: Second background: sidebars, headers, secondary panes.

bg-deep.use: Deepest background: activity bar, wells, the canvas behind panels.

surface.use: Element fill: tab bars, status bars, cards, table headers.

surface-hover.use: Element fill on hover or press.

border.use: Hairlines that separate areas. Decorative, so no contrast minimum.

border-strong.use: Edges that define a control, like an input box.

text-subtle.use: Disabled controls, large text and decoration. Not for text people need to read: WCAG asks 4.5:1 for normal-size text, and this role only has to reach 3:1.

accent.use: Links, focus rings, active marks and icons.

accent-fill.use: Solid fill of primary buttons and active pills.

accent-soft.use: Tinted wash behind selected or active rows.

selection.use: Background of selected text and code.

cursor.use: Text cursor in editors and inputs.

warning.use: Warnings, and attention marks such as keyframes.

syntax-function.use: Function and component names, CSS selectors.
